task_title: Wire metrics counters to plugin hooks
task_criteria: The Metrics dataclass in plugin/terminal_jail/plugin.py has 9 counters that are never incremented outside tests. Add increment calls at the hook sites that already fire: pre_tool_call/post_tool_call in plugin/__init__.py must increment commands_wrapped/commands_wrapped_user_ns/commands_passed_disabled/commands_passed_no_unshare based on the mode and namespace outcome; jail_crashes increments when a sandboxed command exits non-zero; byte_budget_rejections increments when the byte budget check rejects; wrap_time_ns_total and wrap_count increment around the unshare wrap; perf_regression_alert_count increments when a perf alert fires. Add a test in plugin/test_metrics_counters.py that runs a real intercept() call and asserts the counter incremented. Run .venv/bin/python -m pytest plugin/test_metrics_counters.py -v and confirm it passes. Run scripts/metrics-export.py --json and confirm at least one counter is non-zero after a real command.
